ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows approximately 65% high-intensity pixels (white/light grey) against 35% low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) localized primarily in mottling patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense, contiguous dark pixel clusters concentrated at the insertion point of the peduncle and extending along the medial-to-distal axis of the right lobe; sparse, high-frequency dark speckling distributed across the left lobe; a solid dark boundary band along the trailing edge of the left lobe distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 48 degrees and a vertical bounding-box depth equal to approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels, forming a continuous jagged boundary from the median notch to both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the trailing edge transitioning to a sharp, tapered concavity at the distal tips; the right lobe exhibits a more rounded distal extremity compared to the left.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-10 pixel diameter) visible on the medial portion of the right lobe; a large, dense cluster of high-intensity, high-relief calcified structures (barnacles) on the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, roughly horizontal dark-pixel linear disruptions (rake marks) observed in the mid-section of the left lobe, approximately 1/3 of the distance from the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant protruding calcified biomass (barnacle colony) on the distal tip of the right lobe; irregular trailing edge profile on the right lobe suggesting previous minor tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Suspended water droplets and spray partially occlude the pixel data at the fluke-peduncle interface and the lower-right margin of the fluke lobes.
